cc:Work.dc:title: Core and grid-selected comparison activity
cc:Work.dc:description: Two columns show the deterministically selected core and grid-selected comparison. The latter was named exterior by the original grid rule; its saved refinement peak counts are displayed explicitly. The first row plots all three neuron potentials, the second their tanh activations, and the third the logarithmic distance between base and perturbed trajectories. Failed or missing selections are stated rather than replaced. Raw separation can include a persistent phase shift of a stable cycle.

g.text: A small state perturbation is applied at time zero. Raw separation includes neutral phase shifts;
it is not a direct measure of transverse recovery or task correctness.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start
